sn48.48:1.2: Katinnaṃ kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhāvitattā- onāparam
sn48.48:2.2: Pañcannaṃ kho bhikkhave indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti ||
sn48.48:2.6: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīnāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ vyākaroti ||
sn48.48:2.7: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāmī
